name: Misty Swamp Path
desc1: This haunting, claustrophobic marsh is filled a clinging mist which
desc2: leaves the skin feeling cold and clammy. Strange cries echo, muffled,
desc3: in the heavy air, and shadows move just beyond the vision. The ground
desc4: here is spongy and soft, covered in a rank-smelling moss which is a
desc5: little slippery but nonetheless provides a path to walk on.
